CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Holy Spirit to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Holy Spirit has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel: Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel: Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Leadership in Israel: Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel: Saul.
   D. Say Leadership in Israel: Saul has no place in daily life.

   D. Say Faith and God’s Promises has no place in daily life.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Lost Sheep? (1 mark)
